title: Mintaka: A Complex, Natural, and Multilingual Dataset for End-to-End Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating baseline end-to-end question answering models across 9 different languages to measure cross-lingual performance disparities and demonstrate the performance gap between English and non-English questions.
Acknowledging a U.S.-centric bias in the dataset's entities (due to using exclusively U.S.-based crowdworkers) and tracking the regional distribution of the workers.
Surveying the gender distribution of the MTurk crowdworkers who generated the dataset to assess demographic representativeness and potential data skew.
Comparing the racial and ethnic demographics of the dataset annotators against U.S. Census data to identify underrepresented populations in the dataset creation process.
Evaluating the age distribution of the dataset creators against the general population to measure demographic representation.
Measuring the educational attainment and employment status of the dataset workers compared to U.S. Census estimates to identify potential socioeconomic representation bias.
